title: Two New Glitches Now Appear on Every Map

posts.author: Magenta-Fantasies
posts.body:
I’m running into two glitches that have been bothering me for the last month or two. They’re not game-breaking, but they are both easily noticeable and annoying.
One glitch is that Force Action no longer works.
I used to use Force Action to create sequences for special attacks, as seen in this video. (
)
Within the skill, a common event would show the character’s portrait and a randomly-chosen line of dialogue would display, then the actual attack would be a second skill that the common event in the first skill would trigger with Force Action. Even though I haven’t modified these attacks at all in a long time, Force Action stopped working recently. It doesn’t work in any other skills, either.
The other glitch is that at the beginning of each turn, every playable character’s HP is restored,
as indicated by green numbers that appear above each character’s head and indicate how much HP was restored.
I troubleshot all the usual suspects. I checked my eventing for states and skills affected by the glitches, turned off all my plugins, updated the corescript, tried several different versions of the corescript including older versions and more recent versions, and went through all the settings under System 1 and System 2. Still these glitches persist, and they’re really beginning to frustrate me.
These glitches also seem to be overarching, and can appear in combat on any map in the game.
I’m pretty certain that these glitches are not caused by an event/events, because I created a blank map with only an enemy (so I can test for the glitches in combat) and the glitches still happen. That leads me to suspect that they have to do with the core JavaScript, but I never edited any of those JavaScript files. There is no reason that these glitches should suddenly appear, and won’t disappear regardless of which version I upgrade/downgrade the corescript to.
Any thoughts or solutions?

Also, did you try in a test project?

That leads me to suspect that they have to do with the core JavaScript
Click to expand...
Why?
if:
Magenta-Fantasies said:
I never edited any of those JavaScript files
Click to expand...
is true, then there is no reason to suspect the core scripts. If it was actually a bug in the code then I would think more people would be reporting such an issue.
That said, I've seen some reports that there are some changes made to the 1.9 version of MZ. If you upgraded your core scripts to 1.9, and it was working before the update, then revert your core scripts to 1.8
Also, I didn't see that you mentioned checking your troop events. If it happens at the beginning of each turn, it wouldn't be a map event, but a troop. You should check your troop events, and, while I am not familiar with MZ and VS plugins, Yanfly had a plugin that copied a common troop event across all troops. If something similar exists in VS, then maybe you've assigned the wrong troop event in the VS plugin.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Or it may be that the base troop was reset to default when you updated the visustella plugins, which was recently neccessary due to the new core update.
Because both glitches sound as if they are part of the VS Battlesystem - the first one caused by changes to the action sequences, the second one by changes to troop events.
Although this is only a logical guess because I don't use MZ or VS.

That's a good suggestion. I shut down my computer every night, but I rarely use Restart. I restarted my computer today, but it didn't make a difference.
On a positive note, I haven't fixed the "Force Action in a skill" glitch, but I did find a decent workaround where I put commands in the special attack common event that deplete the enemy's HP (although by a set amount) and play the attack animation. The catches are that it has to deal a set amount of damage (since it doesn't use a damage formula) and it doesn't work is for characters who have action sequences in their skills.
EDIT: 3/16/25
It seems that I've found the source of the issue for the HP and MP restoring at the beginning of each turn.
I have a HP Regeneration and MP Regeneration percentage set for each actor under Actors. Apparently the meaning of those terms changed with one of the most recent RPG Maker updates. I believe it used to influence the rate that actors regain HP/MP when they use skills or items that restore those stats. Now it seems to mean that the actors regain HP/MP at the beginning of each turn based on the HP Regeneration and MP Regeneration percentages. That's a really obnoxious change, but at least it's an easy glitch to correct without having to sacrifice anything from my game.
